baseVersions: ledger/account references as required by the command pipeline

creditProfile.repaymentValue: integer; 1..31 for fixed day, 1..366 for days after

effects: no debt, income, budget, or statistical posting

plan.sourceRecordId: required for BILL, absent for CONSUMPTION
plan.capacityRestore: nonnegative Money, no greater than principal

payload.fromTerm: 1-based index of the first scheduled term to replace
payload.changes: optional interest, termCount, interestMode, remainderMode, principalPosting, capacityRestore, firstPostingDate, timezone

rules: all active terms from fromTerm must still be SCHEDULED
job operation ID is the idempotency key

installment.handoff.aggregateId: new plan UUID; base version is 0

payload.postedTerms: contiguous prefix from term 1 with localTermId, scheduledAt, occurredAt, unique localEventId and optional localRecordId
payload.eventMappings: one mapping per posted term: {termIndex,serverEventId,serverRecordId?}; record mapping required only for nonzero derived statistical expense
payload.creationEventMapping: required exactly when the accepted creation effect has nonzero posted debt delta
payload.capacityMappings: one mapping per posted term with the matching localTermId, and occupationEventId / restoreEventId required exactly when derived events are nonzero
payload.paymentMappings: optional [{localPaymentEventId,serverPaymentEventId,allocations:[{termIndex,amount}]}]; validates actual posted TRANSFER facts and appends allocation rows atomically

rules: handoff links verified existing facts without replaying create/posting/statistics/budget/capacity effects for mapped history
term schedule timestamps must equal the civil-date/timezone-derived instant
payment allocations are bounded by actual payment remainder and posted-term principal plus interest
future terms receive SERVER runtime jobs in the same transaction

payload.paymentEventId: same-owner/epoch POSTED TRANSFER with exactly two non-reversal postings: an equally valued negative credit-account LIABILITY posting and negative same-currency ASSET, CASH, or BANK posting

allocations.termId: POSTED installment term on this credit account

rules: each command batch lists a term at most once; later batches may use the exact remaining payment amount, including allocations across different plans
aggregate allocations cannot exceed actual TRANSFER remainder or term principal plus interest
unallocated amount remains in the raw liability balance as prepayment; no income or second posting is created

implemented: credit summary with outstanding scheduled and posted term allocations
partiallyImplemented: restore cutover integration; no restore import module exists in supplied source
notVerified: PostgreSQL migration/transaction/worker/restore execution; database tests NOT_RUN
